evidence_used: The bug report explicitly states: 'The variable dataset is guaranteed to be null in this location, I suppose that the check before that should actually read "if (dataset == null)", not "if (dataset != null)".'
The fix_diff_oracle shows the change from 'if (dataset != null)' to 'if (dataset == null)'.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix does not involve implementing a new algorithm or changing the logic of the method, but rather correcting a simple conditional check that was logically inverted.
